graph.name: search
graph.description: FTS5 full-text symbol search over the code graph, optionally filtered by node kind. Returns ranked symbol hits.

query.description: Symbol name or free text to search for.

graph.name: context
graph.description: Deterministic multi-symbol context bundle for a task description — one call replaces several speculative file reads.

max_nodes.description: Cap on bundle size in nodes (default 25).

include_code.description: Include source code in the bundle (default false).

graph.name: node
graph.description: Everything about one symbol: kind, location, signature, annotations, and immediate edges.

include_code.description: Include the node's source code (default false).

graph.name: callers
graph.description: Direct callers of a symbol (who invokes it).

symbol.description: Symbol whose direct callers to list.

graph.name: callees
graph.description: Direct callees of a symbol (what it invokes).

symbol.description: Symbol whose direct callees to list.

graph.name: impact
graph.description: Transitive impact of changing a symbol, both directions labeled: upstream breaks-if-changed, downstream depends-on.

symbol.description: Symbol whose transitive impact to compute.

graph.name: explore
graph.description: Neighbourhood exploration around a query, with matching source grouped by file.

query.description: Symbol or text to explore around.

graph.name: affected
graph.description: Reverse-transitive closure of files affected by a changed set: every file depending — directly or transitively — on any of the given files. `tests_only` narrows the closure to test files.

tests_only.description: Narrow the closure to test-marked files (default false).

governance.name: scan
governance.description: Full architecture-quality scan (reconcile-then-score): the 0-10000 quality signal, rule violations, and a persisted snapshot. The freshness line reports what was reconciled.

no_reconcile.description: Skip the pre-evaluation reconcile for a tight loop (default false).

governance.name: check_rules
governance.description: Architecture-rules compliance report against rules.toml: constraints, layer ordering (unassigned files exempt), and boundary checks.

no_reconcile.description: Skip the pre-evaluation reconcile for a tight loop (default false).

governance.name: hotspots
governance.description: Hotspot ranking: indexed files ranked by churn-rank × structural-complexity-rank, with a per-file coverage column. The advisory temporal+coverage tier — never moves the gate. Non-git or shallow repos return n/a with a notice.

limit.description: Cap the ranked files returned (default: all).

untested.description: Rank only files with no fresh coverage (default false).

governance.name: dsm
governance.description: Dependency structure matrix: cell (i,j) counts dependency edges i->j; rows ordered by layer order then name. Module granularity by default.

governance.name: gate
governance.description: Quality-gate verdict: the 0-10000 signal compared to the pass/fail threshold, pass/fail, and the contributing breakdown. Read-only — computes the verdict without persisting a snapshot.

governance.name: evolution
governance.description: Quality-signal evolution over stored snapshots with per-metric deltas (default window 30).

governance.name: doc_gaps
governance.description: Documentation-gap analysis: exported functions/methods referenced by no documentation section over doc->code edges (carries the reference-presence caveat).

governance.name: health
governance.description: Architecture health: DB integrity, schema version, FTS coherence, and graph counts. For INDEX freshness use the graph tools' status instead.

no_reconcile.description: Skip the pre-evaluation reconcile for a tight loop (default false).

source.name: read
source.description: Read a UTF-8 source file by its project-relative path. Confined to the project root; absolute paths, `..` traversal, and ignored directories are refused. Long files are truncated.

path.description: Project-relative path of the file to read.

source.name: grep
source.description: Regex search across project source files (gitignore- and ignored-dirs-aware). Optionally scope to a subdirectory. Returns matching lines with file path and line number.

path.description: Optional project-relative subdirectory to scope the search.

source.name: glob
source.description: List project files whose project-relative path matches a glob pattern (e.g. `src/**/*.rs`), gitignore- and ignored-dirs-aware.

pattern.description: Glob pattern matched against project-relative paths.
